import Algebra.Char
import Data.Fintype
import FieldTheory.RootOfUnity
import GroupTheory.Subgroup
import LinearAlgebra.Module
import RingTheory.Ring

open Fintype

theorem lg_target (M : Type u_1) (R : Type u_2) [CommMonoid M] [CommRing R] [Finite M] [HasEnoughRootsOfUnity R (Monoid.exponent Mˣ)] : Nat.card (MulChar M R) = Nat.card Mˣ := by
  let n := Monoid.exponent Mˣ
  have h_root_of_unity : Nat.card (rootsOfUnity n R) = n := HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.natCard_rootsOfUnity M n
  let g : Mˣ := Subgroup.gen Mˣ
  have hg : ∀ x : Mˣ, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g := Subgroup.gen_mem_zpowers Mˣ g
  let ζ : Rˣ := MulChar.ofRootOfUnity_spec M R h_root_of_unity hg g
  let χ : MulChar M R := MulChar.ofUnitHom (ζ ∘ (fun (a : Mˣ) => ↑a))
  have h_char_eq : MulChar M R ≃ₐ (Mˣ →* Rˣ) := MulChar.equivHom
  have h_card_eq : Nat.card (Mˣ →* Rˣ) = Nat.card Mˣ := by
    have h_finite : Finite (Mˣ →* Rˣ) := by
      rw [Finite.def]
      exact ⟨Nat.card (Mˣ →* Rˣ), _⟩
    have h_inj : InjOn (fun (f : Mˣ →* Rˣ) => f g) (Mˣ →* Rˣ) :=
      by intro f₁ f₂ hfg
      cases f₁ with f₁
      cases f₂ with f₂
      congr
      apply hfg
    have h_surj : SurjOn (fun (f : Mˣ →* Rˣ) => f g) (Mˣ →* Rˣ) :=
      by intro y
      let f : Mˣ →* Rˣ := fun (x : Mˣ) => if x = g then y else 1
      exact f
    exact Nat.card_inj h_inj h_surj
  exact h_char_eq.symm.trans h_card_eq
